entities.summary: The copy people use, at https://cyberspace-explorer.com.

entities.deployedBy: GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/cyberspace-explorer.yml): every push to main is tested and deployed to Cloudflare with wrangler deploy, as a Workers custom domain; Run workflow redeploys by hand.
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded. Going back means reverting the change on main, which deploys the earlier version.
